guard: a read runs past the seed gate and writes no seed store or manifest, a command that is not a read still meets the gate, a subcommand's own declaration decides, and a read never loads a built-in installed at another version than the binary's
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/read-no-seed.smoke.ts
why: The suite drives the built binary from a source checkout, where the seed gate refuses to seed, so each mutation rebuilds and the restore rebuilds back.

mutations.name: a read meets the seed gate
mutations.replace: if (cmd && readsOnly(cmd, sub) && name === "") return true;
mutations.expectRed: status is a read: it runs past the seed gate, exit 0
mutations.cell: status is a read: it runs past the seed gate, exit 0

mutations.name: a subcommand takes its command's declaration
mutations.find: return sub ? sub.reads === true : cmd.reads === true;
mutations.expectRed: ext add @acme/none is not a read: the seed gate runs first and refuses from a source checkout
mutations.cell: ext add @acme/none is not a read: the seed gate runs first and refuses from a source checkout

mutations.name: status is not declared a read
mutations.expectRed: status is a read: it runs past the seed gate, exit 0
mutations.cell: status is a read: it runs past the seed gate, exit 0

mutations.name: ext list is not declared a read
mutations.find: usage: "cotal ext list [--json|--plain]", outputs: ["json", "plain"], reads: true },
mutations.expectRed: ext list is a read: it runs past the seed gate, exit 0
mutations.cell: ext list is a read: it runs past the seed gate, exit 0

mutations.name: a built-in at another version loads
mutations.expectRed: status names the older built-in and the command that brings it to this version
mutations.cell: status names the older built-in and the command that brings it to this version

mutations.name: a fresh machine is pointed at ext seed
mutations.expectRed: status on a fresh machine points at cotal setup for the connectors
mutations.cell: status on a fresh machine points at cotal setup for the connectors
